newsitem.title: USA: Citicorp board on visit to Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Citicorp board on visit to Argentina.

text.p: Citicorp chairman John Reed and the global banking group's board of directors left Wednesday for a three-day visit to Argentina, the board's first trip outside the United States since 1991.

Reed told shareholders at the company's annual meeting here that the board would meet Citicorp, business and government officials in Buenos Aires and review Citicorp's operations throughout Latin America.

The board, which includes Colgate-Palmolive Co chairman Rueben Mark and Chevron Corp chairman Kenneth Derr, last traveled as a group outside the United States six years ago, a Citicorp spokesman said.
